Toph Beifong, also known as Toph, is an Earthbending master, one of the most powerful of her time, and the discoverer of Metalbending. Blind since birth, Toph was constantly treated in an overprotective manner because of her "disability", particularly by her overprotective parents, Lao and Poppy Beifong. Upon discovering Badger Moles, animals that dominated the Earth and were also blind, she learned to use earthbending as an extension of her senses. This gave him the ability to "see" all vibrations passing through the floor.

Having developed her own unique style of Earthbending, Toph acquired a hardened personality and became famous for winning Earth Encounter VI under the name "The Blind Bandit", doing so in secret from her parents. Although initially uninterested in directly aiding the war effort, she eventually chose to leave her old life behind, and travel with Avatar Aang and his friends as their Earthbending teacher and ally, when life with her parents finally became unbearable. for her. Toph's total mastery of Earthbending, unique personality, and thoughtful pragmatism made her a valuable addition to the team.

After the formation of Republic City, Toph became the city's first police chief, forming the Republic City police force to help maintain order. She had two daughters by two different men: Lin, who succeeded her as Chief of Police, and Suyin, who created the metal city of Zaofu. Toph eventually left to roam the world in search of enlightenment before settling in the Misty Swamp.

Toph was born in 88 AG as the only daughter of the wealthy Beifong family of Gaoling. Born blind, she was "protected" by her parents, who believed her blindness left her frail and unable to care for herself. They went to extreme measures to protect her, including hiding her existence from the rest of the world, which resulted in very few knowing that the Beifong family even had a daughter. Her parents expected their daughter to be well-mannered and proper due to her noble status in Earth Kingdom society, something Toph secretly disagreed with, causing her to resent her parents' treatment.

At the age of six, Toph ran away from home to a cave inhabited by badger tombs. These animals were the first Earthbenders and according to Toph, she and the creatures got along because they were both blind. She learned the land by imitating its movements. In this way, she learned to "see" through the use of her Earthbending, detecting people and other objects through their vibrations, which she felt through the ground through her bare feet. Her blindness and patience helped her develop an acute sense of hearing.

Lao Beifong later hired earthbending teacher Master Yu to instruct her. Acting under orders from Toph's father, he taught her nothing more than beginner's moves, unaware that she had already achieved mastery of the art. She became such a formidable bender that she secretly entered underground earthen tournaments as the Blind Bandit, and was successful to the point where she became the champion of Earthen Gathering VI more than once. After meeting Aang, Toph soon ran away to teach him earthbending, but also to escape her parents, who never granted her any real freedom.

Work as Chief of Police
After the formation of Republic City, Toph was placed in charge of law enforcement, and became the city's first female police chief. Her knowledge of metalbending allowed her to form an elite team, the Metalbending Police Force, to aid her in her duties.

Sometime before 120 AG, Toph met Kanto, with whom she had a daughter, Lin Beifong. The relationship did not work out, however, and six years later, she had another daughter, Suyin, with another man, although she ended up raising them alone. Both daughters inherited his Earthbending abilities and became masters in their own right. Seeking to give them a different childhood than she had, Toph gave her daughters the freedom to find their own path. Lin would later follow in his footsteps as chief of police, when Suyin became a rebel, much like her mother when she was young. In 124 AG, Toph commissioned a friend to illustrate her first meeting with Aang during Earthen Gathering VI to include in a book he was putting together for her son, Tenzin.

Toph moaned loudly. Although she really enjoyed her job as police chief, it was still tiring to come back after a full day.

She grumbled outside the house before using her earthbending to make a key and open the door.

As soon as she entered, her two daughters, Lin and Suyin ran over and hugged her.

"Mommy!" The two girls scream excitedly at their mother's return.

Meanwhile, you stand against the wall with your arms crossed and a small smile on your face.

Toph notices his presence through the vibrations in the floor. "What about you? Aren't you going to say 'hello' to your wife?" Toph says smiling slightly and with a raised eyebrow and a provocative smile.
